body:
Real, grounded scoping pass answering the founder's 'can we upgrade our compiler to support LLVM directly' ask. Verified LLVM 18/clang-18 fetchable no-sudo, confirmed a working AVR backend is present, and actually compiled examples/avr/blink_main.c to a real AVR .o via clang -target avr with zero avr-gcc involvement. Found linking still needs avr-ld, plus two concrete clang/avr-libc compatibility gaps not yet closed. Distinguished the small 'clang instead of gcc' option from the much larger literal ask (parena itself emitting LLVM IR / linking libLLVM), scoping the latter as a real, separate Phase 3 needing its own design pass. No source/CI changes.

⚓ ☃
title: LLVM backend scoping pass (docs/LLVM_BACKEND_NORTHSTAR.md), no code
